common.data: Warehouse SIP + IEX 1-minute RTH bars, full liquid universe (~1,640-1,950 names/day), sessions 2026-05-11 .. 10-15; halves A <= 07-29 < B. %R lines exactly as wr_trend_trade (desk definitions: fast %R(21) EMA7, slow %R(112) EMA3, minute grid with <= 15-min fill, previous-session warm-up), computed on IEX bars (live feed); all prices SIP. warehouse_confirm (2026-01-14 .. 04-24) stays unread until a PASS.
common.entry: the SIP open of minute t+1 after a signal at the close of minute t (09:45 .. 15:00), unless a test defines its own fill; a missing t+1 bar skips (counted). One open trade per name; first qualifying signal; re-entry only after a new qualifying setup after the exit fill.
common.exit: PRIMARY for every %R-based test: the operator's exit - first u >= entry with fast(u) < fast(u-3), filled at the u+1 SIP open (C2 otherwise), else the last close <= 15:59. T7 uses a fixed 5-minute hold.
common.controls: d = same name, seeded minute in (entry, entry + 60], same hold length; x = seeded other name, same entry/exit minutes (entry bar required, C2 exit); second draws d2/x2 for the MDE. Seeds sha256(sym|day|entry|'b2-<test>-d|x|d2|x2').
common.pass: In BOTH halves: (trade - d) >= +5 bp and (trade - x) >= +5 bp, each t >= 2.0, mean net (5 bp) > 0, and dropping the 3 best days and the top 5 names keeps both lifts >= 0. Batch-robust label: t >= 2.74 in both halves (Bonferroni 0.05/8 scored tests).
common.fail: t <= -2 on either lift in a half; or either lift's 97.5% upper bound < +5 bp in both halves; or the net upper bound < 0 in both halves. Otherwise UNDERPOWERED.
common.power: Outcome-blind count step per test: trades/days per half, MDE = 2.84 x SD(day mean control - control2)/sqrt(days) for d and x, hold distribution; floors >= 300 trades, >= 20 days, MDE <= 5 bp per half; --score refuses otherwise.
common.canary: Before any count step, each test's harness must pass a planted-edge canary (+10 bp stepped after entry, recovered within 1 bp on time-exit trades) on real bars.
common.c4: Fetch failures and missing warehouse names counted; a test with any unrecovered gap is refused.
common.cost: 5 bp round trip binding (3, 10, 20 printed); ETF test 2 bp.
common.confirmation: Any PASS is re-run unchanged on warehouse_confirm (ETF T8: the never-fetched 2026-01-14 .. 04-24 SPY/QQQ window) before anything else; never a desk change by itself.

T1_lag_audit.units: every paper BUY fill 2026-09-16 .. 10-23 (FIFO-matched as floor20_forward.fills), with the decision-ledger arm row that preceded it
T1_lag_audit.measures: for each fill: (a) the minute of the lowest SIP low in the 30 minutes before the fill; (b) the minute of the lowest SIP-computed fast %R in that window; (c) the minute fast %R first rose >= 5 points off that low (the 'turn'); (d) the arm timestamp; (e) the fill timestamp. bp lost at each step = price at the later event / price at the earlier event - 1 (SIP minute closes). Plus the forward 5/15/30-minute SIP return from (c) vs from (e), i.e. what entering at the turn instead of the fill would have changed (information; no verdict).
T1_lag_audit.output: medians and quartiles of each delay (seconds) and each bp step, by arm kind (square / pre-square).

T2_buy_stop.signal: an oversold minute m (both lines <= -80) in 09:45 .. 15:00; a buy-stop rests at high(m) + $0.01 for the next 10 minutes (cancelled if a new oversold minute makes a lower high - the stop then moves to the newer minute's high + $0.01, restarting the 10 minutes).
T2_buy_stop.fill: the first minute k in (m, m+10] whose SIP high >= the stop: filled at max(stop, open(k)) within minute k; the exit rule is evaluated from k+1.
T2_buy_stop.note: enters exactly as price turns up through the oversold minute's high, with no polling lag.

T3_divergence.signal: at minute t: price makes a LOWER LOW than the lowest low of the previous oversold episode in t-30 .. t-5 (an episode = consecutive minutes with fast <= -80), while fast %R at t is HIGHER than that episode's minimum fast, and fast(t) > fast(t-1) (turning up). Entry t+1 open.

T4_deceleration.signal: at minute t: fast <= -80 (still in the bottom zone), slope s1 = fast(t) - fast(t-3) <= 0 but s1 > s0 + 5 where s0 = fast(t-3) - fast(t-6) (falling less steeply by >= 5 points), and the SIP close(t) is within 0.2% of the 30-minute low. Entry t+1 open.

T5_fast_ema3.signal: exactly the wr_trend_trade primary rule, but the fast line smoothed with EMA(3) instead of EMA(7) for entry AND exit (slow unchanged).

T6_volume_dryup.signal: an oversold episode in t-20 .. t with the SIP low of the episode in its last 5 minutes; mean SIP volume of minutes t-2 .. t < 0.5 x mean volume of t-12 .. t-3 (selling dries up); and fast(t) > fast(t-1). Entry t+1 open.

T7_spy_lead.signal: SPY's SIP return over minutes t-1 .. t (close to close) >= +0.10% while the stock's return over the same minutes is <= 0 and the stock's 60-day beta proxy (its 20-session correlation of 1-minute returns with SPY on prior sessions) >= 0.5. Entry t+1 open; fixed 5-minute hold (close of t+5). Controls as common with the same hold.
T7_spy_lead.note: tests a minute-scale lead of the index over lagging high-correlation names.

T8_w_neckline_power_bar.instruments: SPY and QQQ, 2016-01 .. 2026-10-15 ETF cache (held-out window never fetched), long only, 2 bp.
T8_w_neckline_power_bar.signal: on 2-minute RTH bars: SWING HIGH = a bar whose high exceeds the 3 bars on each side (confirmed 3 bars later); NECKLINE = the most recent confirmed swing high; a POWER BAR = 1-3 combined bars (the amended_5 rule of pm_power_bar: >= 1.5x same-clock n-bar median range, >= 50% body, green) whose OPEN or first bar's low is at or below SMA20 and whose close is above BOTH the SMA20 and the neckline, with SMA20 rising or flat; window 10:00 .. 15:29.
T8_w_neckline_power_bar.trade: entry next 1-minute open; stop = the power bar's low - $0.01; target 2R; else 15:59 close. Controls: seeded minute in (end, min(end+60, 15:30)], same % stop/target.
T8_w_neckline_power_bar.post_hoc: designed after anchor_power_bar FAILED and after the operator's chart; a 2016-2026 PASS is only a candidate - it must repeat on the never-fetched 2026-01-14 .. 04-24 window to count.

T9_partial_bar_wr.signal: T5's rule with the fast line recomputed every 15 seconds on SIP trades (the forming minute included); entry at the next 15-second bucket's first trade.
T9_partial_bar_wr.data: SIP trades for a seeded sample of 100 name-days per week (data-only account), sized by a request-budget probe; scored only if the count step is powered.

T10_flow_preturn.signal: in an oversold episode, the first minute whose Lee-Ready signed SIP trade flow over the last 60 s turns net buying (> +20% of volume) while fast %R is still <= -80; entry next minute open.
T10_flow_preturn.data: SIP trades + quotes for oversold episodes in a seeded sample (same budget rule as T9).

multiplicity: 8 scored tests (T2-T8 + the running wr_trend_trade counted separately); batch-robust t >= 2.74; T1 is diagnostic; T9/T10 scored only if powered (then included in the count).

(C2) FEEDS: every price/volume CONDITION compared with the lines uses the line feed (IEX bars): T3 lower low, T4 30-minute low, T6 episode low and volumes, T2 oversold-minute high for the stop LEVEL. (C4) MULTIPLICITY: T9 and T10 are DEFERRED (they need SIP trade/quote infrastructure and budget rules not built; a later batch), so 7 scored tests (T2-T8): batch-robust t >= 2.69 (0.05/7). T8 additionally carries the ETF family bar t >= 2.87 (12 ETF-cache studies).

T1: (1) Lines on IEX (primary) and SIP (second row); the IEX-vs-SIP turn difference reported as the feed component.
(2) Prices: (d) arm = the close of the minute BEFORE the arm timestamp (or the ledger price when present); (e) fill = filled_avg_price.
(3) (c)-vs-(e) forward returns are labelled 'not tradable (hindsight window)'; no rule may come from them without a new prereg; fills with no turn before the fill are counted.

(4) Coverage: fills 2026-09-16 .. 10-23 via a parameterised fills() (not floor20's BASE_FIRST); minute bars fetched for fill name-days after 10-15 (IEX + SIP, data-only account); fills on names never in the warehouse fetched the same way; an arm row matches a fill when it is the last arm_ok row for that symbol within 120 s before the fill (unmatched counted; arm kinds tabulated).
T2: (1) Lifecycle: an oversold IEX minute m in 09:45 .. 15:00 arms a stop at IEX high(m) + $0.01 for m+1 .. m+10; a later oversold minute with a LOWER high moves the stop down and restarts the 10 minutes; one with a HIGHER high is ignored; after expiry the next oversold minute may arm a new stop; fills may occur to 15:10.
(2) Trigger: a SIP high >= stop + $0.01 in minute k; fill at max(stop, SIP open(k)).
(3) The rest of minute k after the fill belongs to the trade; d/x controls enter at a minute open; the canary steps prices after the fill (minute k+1 on).
T3: (1) Previous episode = the most recent maximal run of real IEX minutes with fast <= -80 that ENDED in t-30 .. t-5; if another oversold run is in progress at t-4 .. t, no signal at t.
(2) Lower low on IEX lows: IEX low(t) < the episode's minimum IEX low; fast(t) > the episode's minimum fast; fast(t) > fast(t-1) (t and t-1 real).
(3, skeptic round 2) 'Another oversold run in progress at t-4 .. t' = any real IEX minute with fast <= -80 in t-4 .. t blocks the signal.
T4: (1) Real IEX bars at t, t-3, t-6.
(2) 30-minute low = min IEX low over t-29 .. t inclusive; IEX close(t) <= 1.002 x that low.
T6: (1) The episode = the most recent maximal oversold run ending in t-20 .. t (it may be ongoing at t); its lowest IEX low must fall in the episode's own last 5 minutes.
(2) Volume on IEX bars; all 13 minutes t-12 .. t must be real IEX bars (missing minutes never count as zero).
T7: (1) Correlation filter: mean of the stock's daily 1-minute-return correlation with SPY (SIP closes) over the previous 20 sessions (today excluded), >= 10 sessions present, >= 0.5. The words '60-day beta' are struck.
(2) Warm-up: names lacking 10 prior sessions are excluded and counted (the first ~10 sessions of half A have no candidates).
(3) Real SIP bars at t-1 and t for both SPY and the stock; entry t+1 open; exit = the trade convention at t+6 (the open of t+6, i.e. a 5-minute hold), controls the same.
T8: (1) Halves: A = 2016-01-04 .. 2020-12-31, B = 2021-01-04 .. 2026-01-13 and 2026-04-27 .. 2026-10-15 (held-out never fetched; SMA20 and size references restart 04-27).

(2) Pass = the anchor_power_bar ETF pass: long net (2 bp) > 0 with t >= 2 AND lift vs a seeded later-minute control >= +5 bp with t >= 2 AND drop-3-best-days >= 0, >= 300 long-trade days per half; no cross-name control.
(3) Swing high: a 2-minute bar j whose high exceeds the 3 bars on each side, usable only once bar j+3 has CLOSED before the power bar's first bar starts.
(4) The neckline must be crossed: the power bar's first open or combined low <= neckline < its close.

(5) W required: between the neckline's swing-high bar and the power bar there are two swing lows (bars whose low is below the 2 bars on each side) both below the neckline, the second no lower than 0.3% below the first (a double bottom); renamed 'W-neckline power bar'.

(6) SMA20 = mean of the last 20 two-minute closes through the bar BEFORE the power bar (A_prev); slope = SMA through the power bar >= A_prev; one open trade per symbol, at most 3 per day; skip (counted) if entry <= stop or >= target; 2R target from the entry and stop.

(7) Post-hoc: anchor_power_bar's 'W pattern before the bar' information cell was declared dropped before scoring and never computed (nothing read). Batch-robust bar t >= 2.87. CONFIRMATION (only after a 2016-2026 PASS): the never-fetched 2026-01-14 .. 04-24 SPY/QQQ window, pass = long net > 0 and lift >= 0 (same signs) with >= 20 trades; fewer than 20 trades = 'not confirmable' (no promotion).

(8, skeptic round 2) Swing highs and swing lows are searched within the same session only; the two swing lows are the two most recent confirmed before the power bar's first bar; 'between' excludes the neckline bar itself.
